title: topoling: persistent homology of semantic structure in text
description:
topoling applies persistent homology to text embeddings to ask whether a body of writing is structurally exploratory or converging on a semantic mean.

This release archives Phase 0: a persistent-homology instrument validated on 240 poems (four form arms, 76 poets, PoetryDB) under two embedding models, and the claim it will test next, stated before testing:

Compared with prose by the same authors, cut into segments of the same length, a poem's lines spread more widely across semantic space yet stay linked to one another, giving longer H0 bars than prose but shorter than an unordered bag of lines.

Judged across three embedding models (nomic-embed-text-v1.5, all-mpnet-base-v2, EmbeddingGemma 2): supported if poems' H0 bars are longer than the matched prose under all three; false if longer under none; model-dependent if longer under one or two, reported as such and not counted as support.

The repository is also a dated research log: work items and findings, including withdrawn results, are in backlog/, and CONTRIBUTIONS.md records who contributed what, including AI assistance.
